description: UNRESR + PURR fully ported module-for-module (2026-07-06), genuinely NOT run even once. Suggested Opus verification order in src/purr/README.md: RNG exact-match, uw2/DopplerTable agreement, line_shape tier boundaries, then full pipeline. Unblocks self-shielding + the U-238 20-149 keV unresolved band.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
2026-09-10 verification pass (steps 1-3 and 5 of src/purr/README.md executed; gfortran 13.3.0 installed in-session, so a verbatim-Fortran oracle for rann and uw2 was compiled from purr.f90 and used as the reference). TWO REAL DEFECTS FOUND AND FIXED, both would have silently corrupted URR self-shielding:

(1) unresr::wfun::uw AND purr::wfun::uw2 had the final break-line arm INVERTED. Upstream (unresr.f90:1532-1536, purr.f90:2648-2652): 'if (aimz-brk9.ge.zero) go to 350' (asymptotic) and a false result FALLS THROUGH into label 340 (Taylor). The port had use_taylor = (aimz-1.5 >= 0). Effect: inside the annulus 2.89 <= x^2+1.71y^2, x^2+1.18y^2 < 5.76 (|z| ~ 1.7-2.4) with y < 1.5 the asymptotic series was used where it does not converge: w(2.13+0.001i) = 2.87e-4 in the port vs 1.0907e-2 in Fortran (37x low); w(2+1i) off by 5e-7. UNRESR's 62x62 WTable is built from uw so its nodes near (1.8..2.3, 0..0.3) were wrong. Fixed in both (arm is now aimz-BRK9 < 0); pinned by unresr::wfun::tests::uw_matches_gfortran_uw2_oracle_off_the_imaginary_axis and purr::wfun::tests::uw2_matches_gfortran_oracle (16 oracle points, 1e-12).

(2) purr::wfun::DopplerTable lookups used upstream's 1-based indices (i=ii+2, j=jj-3 coarse, j=jj+2 fine) directly on 0-based rows: every table lookup was one grid cell off in BOTH x and y (returned w(x+0.1, y+0.1)). UNRESR's WTable::lookup had translated correctly (ii+1); PURR's copy had not. Fixed (ii+1 / jj-4 / jj+1), pinned by doppler_table_is_exact_at_its_own_nodes. Also: at the closed tier edges |x|=3.9 / y=3.0 exactly, upstream reads tr(42,.)/tr(.,28), one past its arrays (unchecked OOB read); the port now clamps the cell and extrapolates the quadratic instead (documented).

VERIFIED (tests in src/purr/mod.rs, src/purr/wfun.rs, src/unresr/wfun.rs, all passing): step 1 Rng vs Fortran rann for idum=-101: draws 1-20, 100, 1000, 10000 match to 1e-15. Step 2 uw2 vs Fortran oracle 1e-12; uw2 vs uw identical off the imaginary axis (1240 points); DopplerTable exact at nodes, worst interpolation error 5.5e-3 (fine grid, y->0). Step 3 ladder spacing mean = D within 4 sigma and sd = D*sqrt(4/pi-1) within 2% (20000 spacings); width fractions sum to 1; capture width never fluctuated. Step 5 line_shape: all four tiers vs uw2 at 26 points spanning the 100/6/3.9-3.0/0.5 boundaries within each approximation's accuracy, and tier selection pinned bit-for-bit against the closed-form tier formulas on both sides of every boundary; upstream's fsrch chains re-traced (purr.f90:1950-2204) and the per-point classification is equivalent.

BLOCKER FOR STEPS 4/6 ON U-238: unresr::mf2::parse_lru2_ranges rejects NRO=1 (energy-dependent scattering radius) and U-238's URR range IS NRO=1 (LRU=2 LRF=2 NRO=1 NAPS=0). Upstream reads the TAB1 (unresr.f90:517, purr.f90:806) and interpolates the radius in unresl/unresx. U-235 (2.25-25 keV, NRO=0) and U-234 are usable now. Full NJOY2016 was built in-session (upstream_source/NJOY2016/build/njoy, gitignored) for oracle runs.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
STEPS 4 AND 6 EXECUTED 2026-09-10 against a full NJOY2016 oracle (built in-session) on U-235 (URR 2.25-25 keV, LRF=2, NRO=0, LSSF=1): tests/purr_u235_urr.rs. Deck: reconr 0.001 / broadr 300 K / unresr / purr, sigz 1e10..1, nbin 20, nladr 32, iprint 1.

UNRESR (unresolved_cross_sections) vs NJOY listing at 2.25/5.5/10 keV, sig0=1e10 and sig0=1: every one of the 24 numbers agrees to the 4 printed figures after the fixes below (e.g. 2.25 keV sig0=1: 19.157/12.007/5.267/1.883 vs 19.16/12.01/5.270/1.884). UNRESR IS VERIFIED on U-235.

TWO MORE DEFECTS found by this comparison, both fixed:
(3) purr::infinite_dilution_reference (unresx) fission/capture were 1.6% low at 2.25 keV growing to 6-7% at 10 keV while elastic and spot matched. Cause: upstream unresx passes the REAL amun to unfac2, which folds it into vl (purr.f90:1497-1507), then multiplies by amun again and divides by nint(amun): net GNO*Vl*sqrtE*AMUN. unresl instead calls uunfac(...,one,...) and multiplies by amun once. The port used unresl's un-folded vl with unresx's /nu, halving every AMUN=2 (p-wave) sequence's neutron width - in the analytic reference AND in the sampled ladders (gn_mean). Predicted from the two AMUN=2 sequences' share of capture (1.7%) before fixing; measured after: unresx == port UNRESR to all digits, and vs NJOY's unresx -0.077%.
(4) That remaining -0.077% (identical in RECONR/UNRESR/PURR, invisible in potential scattering): reconr::slbw::WAVE_K was hard-coded 2.1977e-3, the formula rounded UP in the 4th figure; NJOY's cwaven from the same CODATA-2018 constants is 2.196807689e-3. k 0.041% high -> all 1/k^2 resonance terms 0.081% low. Fixed to the exact value with a unit test locking it to sqrt(2*amassn*amu*ev)*1e-12/hbar. NOTE: this shifts every RECONR resonance cross section by +0.08%; tests re-run (see commit).

PURR Monte Carlo (probability_table) at NJOY's first energy 2.25 keV with the same seed kk=-101: probabilities sum to 1, edges ascending, table means reproduce the renormalised infinite-dilution values, Bondarenko monotone in sig0. Self-shielding ratios at sig0=1 b match NJOY's direct-sampling ratios to 0.1%: 0.9562/0.9909/0.9037/0.8968 vs 0.9557/0.9904/0.9035/0.8956 (total/el/fis/cap). Absolute 32-ladder means: port 19.793/12.081/5.688/2.024 vs NJOY 19.842/12.101/5.668/2.074 (pcsd ~1.8/0.4/4.5/4.8%) - within noise for total/elastic/fission, capture 2.4% low (NJOY's own capture mean is 2 sigma ABOVE its analytic reference, the port's 0.6 sigma below). The random streams are NOT bit-identical despite the same seed and apparently the same rann call order (es sampling, then per-sequence ladr2); not chased further - would need per-ladder output from both sides. Test asserts 3% on absolutes and 0.02 on ratios.

REMAINING for U-238: NRO=1 (separate bead).

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
STEPS 4 AND 6 EXECUTED ON U-238 2026-09-10 (tests/purr_u238_urr.rs), completing the ladder on both available URR nuclides once op-as32 (NRO=1) landed. Same NJOY2016 deck as U-235 (moder/reconr 0.001/broadr 300 K/unresr/purr, sigz 1e10..1, nbin 20, nladr 32, iprint 1), MAT 9237, URR 20-149.0087 keV, LRF=2 NRO=1 NAPS=0 LSSF=1, no fission, competition (MT 5/51/800) from 45.107 keV.

Step 4 - infinite_dilution_reference vs UNRESR at sig0=1e10: agree to 2e-3 at 20/60/100/149.0086 keV (elastic, capture; fission identically 0). Both vs NJOY: UNRESR reproduces every printed 4-figure value at sig0=1e10 and sig0=1 at all four energies (20 keV: 14.3609/13.8486/0/0.51237 and 12.9107/12.4713/0/0.43939 vs 14.36/13.85/0/0.5124 and 12.91/12.47/0/0.4394; top of range 10.6249/10.4813/0.14355 and 10.3911/10.2528/0.13832 vs 10.62/10.48/0.1435 and 10.39/10.25/0.1383); unresx reproduces PURR's spot/dbar to 5 figures and the 7-figure MT152 sig0=1e10 column at 20 keV (14.36093/13.84857/0.512367 vs 14.36093/13.84856/0.5123672) and 40 keV (13.29079/12.91497/0.375818 vs 13.29079/12.91497/0.3758178).

Step 6 - probability_table at 20 keV, seed -101, 32 ladders, 10000 samples: aver 14.3509/13.8394/0/0.51146 vs NJOY 14.352/13.841/0/0.51136 (0.01%!), pcsd 1.85/1.87/0/2.99 vs 1.81/1.83/0/2.99, nres 2184 both; direct-sampling Bondarenko at sig0=1: 12.538/12.093/0.44560 vs 12.578/12.133/0.44523 (0.3%); self-shielding ratios 0.8758/0.8759/0.8719 vs 0.8764/0.8766/0.8707. Structural invariants (probabilities sum to 1, edges ascending to 1e6, table means = renormalised infd, Bondarenko monotone in sig0) hold. Random streams still not bit-identical to NJOY's (same as U-235; not chased).

REMAINING, NOT CLOSED BY THIS: (a) MT153 bin-by-bin comparison (bin edges/probabilities vs NJOY's probability table print) - the U-238 20 keV listing is transcribable but was not gated; (b) the port has no PENDF-derived competition sigx: NJOY's rdf3un (lssf=1 sanity check, purr.f90:1195-1215) rewrites bkg to [tot-el-fis-cap,0,0,0] and unrest adds bkg(1) to its totals, so above 45.1 keV PURR's infd total includes sigx (0.17 b at 60 keV, 0.52 b at 100 keV); probability_table accepts that through its bkg argument but infinite_dilution_reference does not model it, so the 7-figure comparison was kept below the threshold (documented in src/purr/README.md); (c) the non-identical random streams. Closing as the verification ladder in src/purr/README.md is complete on both nuclides; (a)-(c) are follow-ups, not blockers.

description:
FOUND while building the steam_table_plotter GUI (op-eebe, GH issue #26), by
plotting the saturation dome that x_ph_flash's own branch logic implies.

WHERE
crates/tampines-steam-tables/src/interfaces/functional_programming/ph_flash_eqm/mod.rs,
in x_ph_flash, the t_sat > 623.15 K branch. The saturated-LIQUID specific
volume is selected as:

    if t_sat_kelvin <= 634.659 { v_tp_3c }
    else if t_sat_kelvin <= 643.15 { v_tp_3s }
    else if t_sat_kelvin <= 646.483 { v_tp_3u }
    else { v_tp_3y }

SYMPTOM
For t_sat in (646.483 K, 647.096 K) -- i.e. p_sat from about 21.93 MPa up to
the critical pressure 22.064 MPa -- the else-branch calls v_tp_3y. IAPWS-IF97's
sub-region 3y is defined ABOVE the critical pressure (roughly 22.064-22.11 MPa),
so below it the polynomial diverges. It does NOT return NaN; it returns a
finite, wildly wrong number.

MEASURED 2026-08-20
At t_sat = 646.503 K, p_sat = 21.906 MPa (a sample the plotter's dome sweep
landed on), the resulting saturated-liquid enthalpy came out as

    h_f = -1.108e21 kJ/kg     (s_f = -1.151e18 kJ/(kg K))

against a physical value of order 2000 kJ/kg. Because the value is finite it
passes any is_finite() filter. In the plotter it collapsed the entire enthalpy
axis of the p-h figure to a range of -1.1e21 .. 0 kJ/kg until it was caught.

CONSEQUENCE FOR THE LIBRARY
x_ph_flash returns x = (h - h_f)/(h_g - h_f). With h_f at -1e21 the quality
comes back as approximately 0.0 for essentially any h, and h_g computed through
the lever rule loses all precision to cancellation. So a (p,h) flash whose
saturation temperature lands in that ~0.6 K band silently reports a wrong
quality rather than erroring. Every consumer of x_ph_flash in the near-critical
band is affected: kappa_t_ph_eqm interpolates on it, and the choked-flow
dispatcher routes on it.

Note the saturated-VAPOUR chain in the same function may have the same shape of
problem (its thresholds are 640.691 / 643.15 / 646.599, then v_tp_3z); it was
not separately diagnosed here because the liquid divergence masked it.

SUGGESTED NEXT STEP (not done -- this is a library fix, out of scope for op-eebe)
Check the sub-region selection against the IAPWS-IF97 supplementary release for
backward equations v(p,T) in Region 3, specifically which sub-region covers the
saturated-liquid line between 21.93 MPa and p_crit. Add a verification test at
t_sat = 646.5 K asserting h_f is of order 2000 kJ/kg. Consider adding an
ordering guard (h_f <= h_g, s_f <= s_g) so a diverged polynomial cannot be
returned as a valid state.

WORKAROUND IN PLACE (plotter only, does NOT fix the library)
examples/steam_table_plotter/curves.rs::saturation_state tries v_tp_3u first in
that band, validates the resulting state with
SaturationState::is_physically_ordered (h_f <= h_g, s_f <= s_g, h_f >= -1 kJ/kg),
and falls back to the neighbouring sub-region, dropping the sample if neither
works. That keeps the figures honest; it does not touch x_ph_flash.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
FIXED 2026-08-20. Root cause was narrower than first diagnosed: only
x_ph_flash's own copy of the sub-region chain was broken. The other three
functions with an identical-looking chain in the same file (v_ph_eqm,
u_ph_eqm, s_ph_eqm) already gated their final (t_sat > 643.15 K) branch on
PRESSURE (p_mpa <= 21.9010 / <= 21.9316), matching v_tp_3u/v_tp_3x/v_tp_3y/
v_tp_3z's own doc-commented validity windows in MPa. x_ph_flash's copy alone
used TEMPERATURE-only thresholds (t_sat_kelvin <= 646.599 / <= 646.483) for
that same branch, so it could and did fire v_tp_3y outside its valid pressure
window -- confirmed exactly at the bug's own measured case (t_sat=646.503K,
p=21.906 MPa): v_tp_3u there gives v=2.6124e-3 m3/kg -> h_f=1993.29 kJ/kg
(sane), v_tp_3y gives v=3.076e-5 m3/kg -> h_f=-5.64e21 kJ/kg (the recorded
garbage). Fix: copied the already-correct pressure-gated pattern from the
other three functions into x_ph_flash (crates/tampines-steam-tables/src/
interfaces/functional_programming/ph_flash_eqm/mod.rs).

FIRST ATTEMPT, reverted: I initially replaced the WHOLE chain in all four
functions with a general-dispatcher-plus-temperature-nudge scheme
(v_tp_3(t_sat +/- eps, p), leaning on the crate's own fully-correct near-
critical `subregion()` map in backward_eqn_pt_3). That version fixed the
measured -1e21 case too (h_f=1993.07 kJ/kg, matching), and self-consistency-
checked cleanly against several points -- but it also replaced ALREADY-
correct code (the other three functions' pressure-gated final branch, which
was never broken) and introduced new regressions verified against this
crate's own reference-table tests: at t_sat=643.15 K exactly (the row the
crate's own saturation_table_260_degc_to_crit_temp_373_946_degc.rs literally
comments "very near critical point, this kinda fails bad") a tiny eps=1e-6 K
nudge landed BOTH the liquid and vapour probes on the same sub-region (a
genuine corner where several named sub-regions meet), and larger eps values
that worked there caused wrong-side jumps at other points near 21.93 MPa.
No single fixed epsilon covered both. Rather than build a more elaborate
adaptive-epsilon scheme under time pressure, I fell back to the narrower fix
above, which is a one-line-pattern-copy from code the crate's own test suite
already validates, not new numerical machinery.

VERIFIED: full library suite (cargo test --release -p tampines-steam-tables
--lib) is 959 passed, 0 failed, 13 ignored -- unchanged pass count from
before this fix (confirms no regression), and the previously-recorded
sic... I mean the previously-recorded h_f=-1e21 case now returns h_f=1993.29
kJ/kg instead. cargo check --workspace --lib --tests also clean.

REMAINING (not done, follow-up if wanted): the two SAME-ISSUE gap tests in
outram-mc-libs's triso_shell tests are unrelated to this crate; not
applicable here. The near-critical quality-formula ill-conditioning noted
during investigation (h_g - h_f -> ~0.0007 kJ/kg within ~0.6 K of Tc, making
x = (h-h_f)/(h_g-h_f) numerically enormous for any h even slightly off) is
real physics already documented in this crate's own "Known accuracy
pitfalls" (CLAUDE.md: "Region 3 backward equations lose digits within ~0.5 K
of Tc"), not a defect introduced or left by this fix -- no clamp was added,
since that would be new scope beyond the diagnosed dispatch bug.

title: tampines-steam-tables: x_ph_flash Region-3 saturated-liquid sub-region chain picks v_tp_3y below the critical pressure
